title: EvolveAI Memory Exchange Envelope
description: Versioned export/import envelope for EvolveAI memory units. Mirrors the schema conventions of MythologIQ-Labs-LLC/agent-memory (JSON Schema draft 2020-12, repo-path $id, semver schema_version, closed objects). An envelope is an evidence-bearing snapshot of exported memory, not a grant of authority: importing systems MUST treat every unit as acquisition_mode 'imported' with local trust and lifecycle state re-derived under their own governance (agent-memory docs/35-interoperability-profiles.md, 'Authority conflict between systems').

schema_version.description: Semver of this exchange contract. This document describes 1.0.0.

snapshot_version.description: Internal snapshot format version of the exporting store (evolve-core SNAPSHOT_VERSION), when the export was derived from a persisted snapshot.

doctrine_ref.description: Pointer to the doctrine repo/version this export claims alignment with, e.g. 'MythologIQ-Labs-LLC/agent-memory'.

attestation.description: Provenance attestation binding the export to the exporting ledger head. Proves which chain state produced the export; it does NOT prove that every exported unit's content matches its ledgered hash (see INTEROP.md, L3 mutability lesson).

index.description: Index of the latest block in the exporting hash chain.

hash.description: Hex hash of the latest block.

timestamp.description: Block timestamp, Unix epoch milliseconds (evolve-core native representation).

genesis_hash.description: Hash of the exporting chain's genesis block, identifying the chain lineage.

chain_verified_at_export.description: True if Ledger::verify() (block linkage + block hash recomputation) passed at export time. Note: this verifies linkage only, not stored-entry-to-data_hash correspondence.

address.description: BLAKE3 content address (UorAddress) of the original content. Identity contract: identical content yields identical address. Importers that receive 'content' MUST recompute and compare before treating the address as verified identity; an address without content is a reference, not proof.

content.description: Raw content, when the exporter retains it. evolve-core MemoryUnit stores an embedding, not raw content, so exports from the current implementation carry null here unless content is supplied from an external store; the address then cannot be independently re-verified by the importer.

tier.description: Exporting tier at export time. Advisory routing fact, not an instruction: importers route under their own policy.

state.description: Lifecycle state mapped to the agent-memory lifecycle vocabulary (agent-memory docs/02-lifecycle-state-machine.md, schemas/memory-unit.schema.json 'state'). See INTEROP.md section 3 for the EvolveAI tier-to-state mapping and its declared subset.

score_kind.description: Declared semantics per agent-memory docs/03-scoring-and-decay.md: sigma is an ordinal routing score, never a calibrated probability.

calibrated.description: Always false for current evolve-core exports; no calibration protocol run exists yet.

model.description: w = exp(-lambda_eff * elapsed), lambda_eff = (ln2 / half_life_ms) * (1 - sigma) * ln2. See crates/evolve-core/src/memory/decay.rs.

pressure.description: Memory-pressure factor at export; pressure shortens effective half-life (crates/evolve-core/src/processor/slo.rs).

level.description: Exporter-local trust classification (evolve-core TrustLevel). Evidence about the exporter's view; MUST NOT be imported as local trust — importers re-derive trust under their own source-trust policy (agent-memory docs/16-source-trust-and-reputation.md).

provenance.description: Mirrors the required provenance block of agent-memory schemas/memory-unit.schema.json.

origin.description: Source system or InputMetadata.source of the original ingestion; 'unknown' when the exporter did not record one.

observer.description: Component that encoded the memory, e.g. 'evolve-core/encoder'.

edges.description: Outgoing associative edges from the L2 temporal graph. Edge weight is an associative signal, never authority or identity.

ledger_ref.description: Present only for L3 units: the chain block recording this unit's crystallization append.

data_hash.description: SHA-256 of the serialized MemoryUnit as appended at crystallization time. May not match the unit's current serialized form (see INTEROP.md, L3 mutability lesson).
